quiz.question: A PC is slow and the disk light never stops. Where in Task Manager do you see which app is using the disk?
options: Processes, sorted by the Disk column
quiz.answer_text: Processes, sorted by the Disk column
quiz.why: The Processes tab has a Disk column. Sort by it to find the app hammering the drive.
